name: io.github.tonyyang0504/ingram_micro-mcp
description: Ingram Micro (Xvantage / Developer Portal) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, qu

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID (Consumer Key) of your app on developer.ingrammicro.com (My Apps); production keys after app approval.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client Secret of the same app; exchanged for a bearer token at /oauth/oauth30/token (client_credentials).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_CUSTOMER_NUMBER
environmentVariables.description: Your Ingram Micro reseller customer number (IM-CustomerNumber header, e.g. 20-222222).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_COUNTRY_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Two-letter ISO country of your Ingram Micro account (IM-CountryCode header, e.g. US).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_SENDER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional sender identification text (IM-SenderID header, max 32 chars).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_CUSTOMER_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: E-mail of the logged-in user (IM-CustomerContact header); required by Freight Estimate (quote_shipping).
